column12: 5eb3d3c7d0 (Message.SortAndSaveAttachments) stops assuming that content IDs are unique; here two attachments carry the same PidTagAttachContentId, and both are listed with their own content

column4: The Unicode header declared rgbReserved as 4 bytes instead of 2, misplacing the fields after it
column12: not used: the fields the wrong width displaced, bidNextB and dwCRCFull, are not read by Bodu, whose header parse stops at bCryptMethod (offset 513) and checks dwCRCPartial only

column12: API: S/MIME decryption, which Bodu does not offer

column4: CSV export did not quote values holding commas, quotes or line breaks as RFC 4180 requires
CSV export lost non-ASCII text (it now writes UTF-8 and quotes every value)
CSV export used a comma whatever the list separator of the culture
The folder tree's context menu crashed when the clicked node was not selected
Reading certain 64-bit OST files crashed: the 4 KiB-page block B-tree entry was given 4 bytes of padding instead of 2
column12: format extension: the 4 KiB-page OST format, which Bodu rejects (PstUnsupportedFormatException)

column4: B-tree entries were mapped without checking that the page's entry size holds them
column12: 8ce209a33f (Map.MapType) refuses an entry structure larger than the page's cbEnt; MS-PST 2.2.2.7.7.1 makes cbEnt at least the size of the page's entry, 32 bytes for a Unicode NBTENTRY, so a node B-tree page declaring 16 is malformed

column4: A message table query was evaluated lazily on another thread
column12: language: deferred evaluation of a query across threads in XstReader's UI

column4: Non-ASCII characters of HTML bodies were garbled on display
column12: UI: the WPF browser control garbles non-ASCII text passed to NavigateToString, so the viewer now writes it as character references; the HTML was already decoded with its code page

column4: Sender names did not show for files written by Office 2013 and later
column12: UI: XstReader's message-list From column, which now shows PidTagSentRepresentingName before the address (the issue concerns a 4 KiB-page OST file); Bodu has no From column and documents SenderName as PidTagSenderName (docs/guides/outlook/reading-pst-mail-stores.md, the message conveniences)

column4: Subfolders were read only when the folder declared PidTagSubfolders, which files from other applications do not always set
column12: bc9b7fa96d (XstFile.ReadFolderStructure) reads the hierarchy table whatever PidTagSubfolders says; here the Inbox declares PidTagSubfolders false yet its hierarchy table lists Sub, and HasSubfolders reports the declared value while enumeration follows the table (docs/guides/outlook/reading-pst-mail-stores.md, Pattern 1)

column4: A table with no rows, whose hnidRows is 0, could not be read
column12: 378d1e4dc8 (LTP.ReadTableInternal) returns no rows when hnidRows is 0, which MS-PST 2.3.4.1 sets for a table without rows; here the Inbox's contents table is empty

column4: Attachment properties held in the attachment's own subnode tree were looked up in the message's
column12: b4aea2d8c7 (LTP.ReadAllProperties) resolves an attachment's property values through the attachment's own subnode tree; here PidTagAttachLongFilename is subnode 0x0001001F of the attachment while the message body is subnode 0x0001001F of the message (MS-PST 2.4.6.2)

column4: Office 2013 and 2016 files with compressed control structures, such as messages with very many attachments, were misread
column12: format extension: the compressed blocks of the 4 KiB-page OST format, which Bodu rejects (PstUnsupportedFormatException)
